Mini mPOS takes payments with the Adyen Terminal API: on the terminal it runs on, on a terminal on your network or over the internet (cloud), or with Tap to Pay in the Adyen Payments app. It uses Adyen’s Java API library. Messages to a terminal or the Payments app are encrypted with the shared key; cloud requests are authenticated with your API key.
